key_findings: The reusable system was expanded through tokens, shell framing, section wrappers, and card primitives without touching route files.
Placeholder pages now inherit stronger editorial and responsive design foundations through shared components only.
Design authority remained unchanged, and Contact stayed out of design-parity scope.
design_system_decisions: Use global CSS custom properties for tokenized color, type, spacing, radius, and shadow values.
Represent design rhythm through framed sections, a split hero pattern, and capsule navigation.
Keep route-level implementation deferred by upgrading shared placeholder composition rather than editing route files.
